references.text: The priest shall go out of the camp to inspect, which shows the priest's role in examining and assessing uncleanness.
The priest shall come and look at the house, and if the plague has spread, the house must be torn down. This continues the instructions regarding the uncleanness of a house.
The priest shall examine the plague on the skin, which shows the priest's responsibility to inspect and declare uncleanness or cleanness.

Everything that becomes unclean through contact with unclean things, including objects in the house, must be cleansed. This illustrates the principle that uncleanness can spread to everything in a house.
Everything in the tent becomes unclean when someone dies there, which illustrates how uncleanness can spread to objects in a dwelling.
Israel shall carefully follow the priests' instructions regarding leprosy, as commanded, which confirms the priest's authority in these matters.
